metadata.description: Official Voicenter Claude Code plugins — live MCP access, API integration skills for all 14 Voicenter APIs, a 3-skill bot-builder authoring pipeline, and an end-user Dashboard/support-center knowledge base

plugins.name: voicenter-mcp
plugins.description: Live access to all Voicenter APIs directly from Claude Code via the MCP server at mcp01.voicenter.co. Authenticated via OAuth — no manual token setup required.

plugins.name: voicenter-api
plugins.description: Skills for all 14 Voicenter APIs: VoiceBot, Click2Call, Pop-Up Screen, CDR Notification, External Layer, Call Log, Blacklist, Mute Recording, Extension List, Real-Time, Productive Dialer, Login/Logout, Lead Tracker, Active Calls.

plugins.name: voicenter-bot-builder
plugins.description: Three-skill pipeline for designing and generating Voicenter Bot JSON: Agent Spec Designer (interview), Intent Detail Author (per-intent language), JSON Assembler (wire-format projection). Produces a deployable bot-<name>-<date>.json.

plugins.name: voicenter-dashboard
plugins.description: End-user knowledge base of Voicenter's support center (voicenter.co.il): the Dashboard/Monitor interface and all 193 monitoring report/chart templates (with template numbers), plus Cpanel, call history, Softphone, Auto-Dialer, Chrome extension, networks, recording storage, security, account setup, SSO, CRM, mobile, VoiceBot, and AI call analysis.
